summary: Tested SMS Provider Service Names rework (iteration 19). All key requirements verified: Tiger SMS and SMS Bower return proper service names (WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.) instead of codes (wa, tg). SMS Bower countries API returns proper country names (Afghanistan, USA) not numeric codes. SERVICE_NAMES dictionary successfully maps 400+ Tiger SMS service codes to full names. UI correctly shows 4 provider cards with generic names (Premium Server, Server 1, Budget Server, Fast Server) hiding real provider names from users.

minor.issue: Country=0 returns 0 services (empty), but country=74 (Afghanistan) and country=187 (USA) work correctly with full service names
65.6% of services have proper names from SERVICE_NAMES dictionary. 34% still show codes (new services from Tiger SMS API without mappings)
